abstract: PURPOSE: The aim of this study was to assess the surgical intervention strategies for pediatric ovarian tumors. METHODS: The clinical features and treatment were analyzed for 60 children with ovarian tumors treated at our institution between 2000 and 2010. RESULTS: Twenty-one of the 60 patients were prenatally diagnosed neonatal cases with cystic lesions. Of the 21 neonates, surgery included ultrasound-guided aspiration in 14 cases, salpingo-oophorectomy by umbilical crease incision in 6 cases with torsions, and cystectomy with ovarian preservation in one case with torsion. The mean age of the other 39 patients was 9.3 years. For 31 of these patients with benign lesions, surgery included tumor resection with ovarian preservation after aspiration of the cystic lesion through a modified Rocky Davis incision in 21 cases containing 3 torsion cases, and salpingo-oophorectomy in 10 cases, including 8 torsion cases. A salpingo-oophorectomy was performed for all eight of the patients with malignant tumors, including borderline lesions of mucinous or serous cyst adenoma, and postoperative chemotherapy was administered for two yolk sac tumors and one dysgerminoma. Only one case demonstrating a yolk sac tumor with lung metastasis at initial diagnosis died of disease after recurrence. CONCLUSIONS: The majority of pediatric ovarian tumors were benign disease, and the patients with malignant lesions had a good prognosis. In neonatal cases, an umbilical crease incision approach is feasible and provides excellent cosmesis. We recommend tumor resection with ovarian preservation through a minimally invasive approach (modified Rocky Davis incision) as the first line treatment for older pediatric patients with ovarian tumors other than those preoperatively diagnosed as malignant.

目的：小児卵巣腫瘍に対する外科的治療戦略を評価すること。
方法：2000年から2010年の間に当施設で治療された小児卵巣腫瘍60例の臨床的特徴と治療を解析した。
結果：60例中21例は出生前に嚢胞性病変と診断された新生児症例であった。これら21例の新生児では、超音波検査ガイド下穿刺吸引を14例に、臍部皺襞切開による卵管卵巣摘出術を6例（捻転症例）に、捻転を伴う1例では卵巣温存囊腫摘出術を行った。残る39例の平均年齢は9.3歳であった。このうち良性病変の31例では、嚢胞病変の穿刺吸引後に修正Rocky-Davis切開から腫瘍切除と卵巣温存を行った症例が21例（捻転3例を含む）、卵管卵巣摘出術を10例（捻転8例を含む）に行った。境界悪性の粘液性または漿液性嚢胞腺腫を含む悪性腫瘍8例には全例で卵管卵巣摘出術を行い、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例と未分化胚細胞腫1例に術後化学療法を施行した。初診時に肺転移を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例のみが再発後に原病死した。
結論：小児卵巣腫瘍の大半は良性であり、悪性病変の患者は良好な予後を示した。新生児では臍部皺襞切開のアプローチが実施可能で、優れた整容性をもたらす。術前に悪性と診断されていない年長の小児卵巣腫瘍患者に対しては、低侵襲アプローチ（修正Rocky-Davis切開）による卵巣温存腫瘍切除を第一選択治療として推奨する。
